advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Strengthen Cloud-S3 test_unknown_project_skips_and_continues to also assert REB and DIG keys are present in the snapshot (e.g. counts >= _MIN_ISSUES_PER_PROJECT), not just that REBGHOST is absent.
evidence: Docstring at lines 250-251 claims 'the fetch still returns the REB/DIG results rather than aborting', but no assertion verifies REB/DIG keys are present.
_projects_of returns a Counter of prefix->count; an empty snapshot yields an empty Counter which still passes the 'not in' check (lines 82-88).
docstring: "the fetch still returns the REB/DIG results rather than aborting" — but no assertion checks REB/DIG presence
An empty snapshot satisfies `"REBGHOST" not in _projects_of(...)` just as well as a correct skip-and-continue snapshot (regression-blindness, criterion (d))
advisory.finding: The Cloud-S3 test_unknown_project_skips_and_continues asserts only that the ghost project contributes no keys ('REBGHOST' not in _projects_of(snapshot.keys())) but never asserts the real REB/DIG projects still produced keys; a total-failure/empty snapshot would also satisfy this assertion, so it does not actually prove the skip-and-continue contract the docstring claims ('the fetch still returns the REB/DIG results').
merged_from: The Cloud-S3 rehearsal test_unknown_project_skips_and_continues only asserts that REBGHOST is absent from the snapshot; it never asserts that the real mapped projects (REB/DIG) still landed. A snapshot that degraded to empty (or a regression where the whole pass returns nothing) would pass this assertion trivially, so the test cannot detect a regression in the skip-AND-CONTINUE contract it documents ('the fetch still returns the REB/DIG results rather than aborting').
scenarios: A regression that makes the whole multi-project fetch fail-closed or return empty would leave this test green, defeating the negative control.
advisory.suggested_fix: After the snapshot call, add: by_project = _projects_of(snapshot.keys()); assert by_project[REB_PROJECT] >= _MIN_ISSUES_PER_PROJECT and by_project[DIG_PROJECT] >= _MIN_ISSUES_PER_PROJECT; assert 'REBGHOST' not in by_project.

advisory.finding: The DC rehearsal test_unknown_project_skips_and_continues now calls bridge_preview/bridge_sync purely for their no-raise effect and asserts only after == before (zero mutation). Zero-mutation was ALSO true under the previous fail-closed contract, so this assertion does not distinguish skip-and-continue from a pass that silently produced no reconciliation over the other projects. There is no positive assertion that the other mapped projects still reconciled.
scenarios: A regression where the unknown key is skipped but the sibling projects' reconciliation is also dropped, leaving live data untouched
